ideas.pitch: Real-time logistics route optimization using Condense streaming to minimize both delivery time and carbon emissions.
ideas.title: CondenseRoute: Carbon-Aware Fleet Routing
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles logistics optimization while mirroring the carbon footprint optimization strategies that won prior competitions like the IBM Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An edge-to-cloud streaming digital twin that monitors EV cell temperature, voltage anomalies, and predicts remaining battery life using Condense.
ideas.title: TwinCell: Real-Time EV Battery Digital Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds directly on proven 1st-place battery intelligence backend architectures while utilizing real-time streaming infrastructure.

ideas.pitch: A real-time geofencing engine processing live vehicle coordinate streams via Condense to trigger automated logistics dwell-time and perimeter alerts.
ideas.title: GeoFencePulse: Instant Depot Perimeter Alerts
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages high-frequency geospatial processing patterns similar to winning maritime and industrial monitoring systems.

ideas.pitch: A streaming analytics pipeline that ingests raw telematics to flag harsh braking, rapid acceleration, and driver fatigue indicators instantly.
ideas.title: SafeSteer: Real-Time Driver Harsh-Event Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses driver safety with immediate, actionable anomaly detection that appeals directly to Bosch's focus on mobility platforms.

ideas.pitch: Early-warning maintenance dashboard utilizing streaming engine sensor metrics through Condense to predict component failures before they happen.
ideas.title: FleetPulse: Predictive Maintenance Telemetry Stream
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a high-value industrial problem for fleet operators with clear economic impact and robust real-time data flow.
